note: Run recipes transcribed from each row's exec/<row>/verify.py; that file remains the authority. {root} is the repository root; {task}, {row}, {toolchain}, {PATH} and {env:NAME} are also substituted by exec/harness.py. `language` is the README results table's Language column for the row.

a68g.name: Algol 68 Genie
a68g.what: a compiler-interpreter: parses and executes, no build step

asm.name: none — hand-written machine code
asm.what: an assembler, not a compiler: the source already is machine code

beam.name: BEAM
beam.what: the Erlang VM's per-process scheduler and JIT

dmd.name: DMD
dmd.what: Digital Mars D, its own backend

dolphin.name: Dolphin VM
dolphin.what: a prebuilt image on Dolphin's VM

factor.name: Factor
factor.what: Factor compiles the script and runs it on every invocation

fpc.name: FPC
fpc.what: Free Pascal Compiler, its own backend

gcc.name: GCC
gcc.what: the GNU Compiler Collection: parses, optimises and emits machine code

go.name: Go (gc)
go.what: Go's own SSA backend and linker

godot.name: Godot
godot.what: Godot parses and runs the script

graalvm-jit.name: GraalVM JIT
graalvm-jit.what: the Graal compiler replacing HotSpot's C2

graalvm-native.name: GraalVM native-image
graalvm-native.what: ahead-of-time native image built from the same class files

icx.name: Intel oneAPI (DPC++)
icx.what: Intel's downstream LLVM fork (clang 24 from intel/llvm), a different build and optimisation pipeline from upstream clang

janet.name: Janet
janet.what: Janet compiles to bytecode on every run

jscript.name: JScript
jscript.what: the Windows Script Host JScript engine

julia.name: LLVM (JIT)
julia.what: per-method LLVM compilation on first call

llvm.name: LLVM
llvm.what: LLVM IR and an LLVM backend (clang, rustc, swiftc, zig, ldc2, ...)

lobster.name: Lobster
lobster.what: Lobster compiles to bytecode, then runs it

lute.name: Lute
lute.what: the Luau team's own runtime, for the tasks luau.exe cannot run

mono.name: Mono
mono.what: Mono's JIT, a different runtime from CoreCLR

msvc.name: MSVC
msvc.what: Microsoft's cl.exe: parses, optimises and emits machine code

openj9.name: OpenJ9
openj9.what: Eclipse OpenJ9's JIT, a different VM from HotSpot

pharo.name: Pharo VM
pharo.what: a prebuilt image on Pharo's Cog VM

quickjs.name: QuickJS
quickjs.what: QuickJS compiles to bytecode, then its own VM

sbcl.name: SBCL
sbcl.what: SBCL compiles to machine code at run time and on demand

tcc.name: TCC
tcc.what: Tiny C Compiler: one pass, no optimisation

unicon.name: Unicon
unicon.what: icont compiles to icode, appended to the executable

v8.name: V8
v8.what: tiered JIT (Ignition + TurboFan); here it runs the wasm module through the WASI shim

vbscript.name: VBScript
vbscript.what: the Windows Script Host VBScript engine

wamr.name: WAMR (iwasm)
wamr.what: WebAssembly Micro Runtime; the release build JITs via LLVM or interprets

wasm-edge.name: WasmEdge
wasm-edge.what: WasmEdge JITs the module on every run

wasmtime.name: wasmtime (Cranelift)
wasmtime.what: Cranelift JITs the wasm module on every run -- wasmtime's optimising compiler

winch.name: wasmtime (Winch)
winch.what: Winch, wasmtime's baseline single-pass compiler, on the same modules as Cranelift

zend-jit.name: Zend JIT
zend-jit.what: opcode JIT on top of the Zend VM

entries.note: -H 256 is the row's documented run line (Poly/ML's initial heap in MB). All fifteen tasks run from the build directory, which is where build_all.bat stages data.bin; RUN.md's sentence about sources/standardml describes the source header's run line.
